source: Dr. Fady's 10 real student questions (tested on the deployed bot, 18 Nov 2026)

cases.title: How should I plan my bachelor? (vague planning)
turns: How should I plan my bachelor?
variants: how do i plan my degree
كيف أخطط لدراستي في البكالوريوس؟
how shud i plan my bachelors
cases.expect: Asks program + admit term; gives short planning steps (study plan by semester, prerequisites, degree audit, advisor, graduation rules 120 credits / 2.00 GPA / no I grades).

cases.title: How to raise ceiling? (student slang)
variants: كيف أرفع سقف الشعبة؟
how do i get a seat in a full section
section is full 40/40 how to get in
how to rais celing for a course
cases.expect: Recognises raise ceiling / رفع سقف = request a seat in a full section (CLOSED SECTION override); gives the procedure with source.

cases.title: View summer course offerings
turns: How can I view the list of courses offered for the upcoming summer term?
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
How can I view the list of courses offered for the upcoming summer term?
variants: where can i see which courses are offered in summer
كيف أشوف المواد المطروحة في الفصل الصيفي؟
summer course list uaeu
cases.expect: No program question; steps to the class schedule search / Look Up Classes in the registration portal, filtered by the summer term; official link.

cases.title: Which courses to register next semester
turns: How do I know which courses I should register for next semester?
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
variants: what courses should i take next sem
كيف أعرف المواد اللي لازم أسجلها الفصل الجاي؟
cases.expect: Asks program once, then admit term + current semester (or answers generally): follow cohort study plan, degree audit, prerequisites, advisor; never loops or shows internal messages.

cases.title: How to add a course
variants: how do i add a class
كيف أضيف مادة؟
cases.expect: Step-by-step registration guide (MyUAEU path, Add, Submit, Registered), closed-section note, add/drop deadline link.

cases.title: Closed section override request
turns: How to request a closed section override?
variants: closed section override how
الشعبة مغلقة كيف أطلب استثناء؟
cases.expect: Concrete steps: where/how to request, what to include, who decides, deadline (add/drop period), how to check result; official source.

cases.title: How to calculate GPA
turns: How do I calculate my GPA?
variants: how is gpa calculated
كيف أحسب معدلي التراكمي؟
cases.expect: Grade table, formula, worked example, term vs cumulative, portal for official GPA.

cases.title: University working hours
turns: What are the university's working hours?
variants: uaeu working hours
متى دوام الجامعة؟
what time does the university open
cases.expect: Official working hours (days/times) or the official page; note offices may differ; optionally ask which office.

cases.title: Withdraw from the university
turns: How to drop out of the uni?
variants: how do i withdraw from uaeu completely
كيف أنسحب من الجامعة؟
cases.expect: Withdrawal from the university: steps, form/office, deadlines, refund/fees note, consequences, official source.

cases.title: How to apply for graduation
variants: how do i apply to graduate
كيف أقدم على التخرج؟
cases.expect: Steps (where/portal or College Advising Unit), deadline for current term with calendar link, eligibility, what happens next; current policy.
